notes.title: Silenthead new enemies and rooms!
notes.content:
Hi! 
We made a first Early access update which includes:


 6 new enemies 
     
     RageHead - strong enemy, shows vision rage.
     RageHead (shielded)- strong enemy, shows vision rage with shield.
     Kolo - light enemy with bigger HP pool then regular Woodhands.
     Masked Kolo - light enemy with bigger HP pool and grater damage.
     Saw Hemp - combined Saw and hemp enemies.
     Larva's Head - the head of the larva.
     
 6 new rooms
     
     2 new rooms in the 2 stage of 1 Tower
     2 new rooms in the 2 stage of 2 Tower
     1 new rooms in the 2 stage of 3 Tower
     1 new rooms in the 2 stage of 4 Tower
